name: Regular Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF CANCELLATION
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that regular meeting of the City Council scheduled
to be held at 7:00 p.m. on January 8, 2024 Artesia City Hall is hereby cancelled.

The next meeting is scheduled to be held at 7:00 p.m. on January 17, 2024 at Artesia
City Hall Council Chambers located at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia, California
90701.
Dated: January 4, 2024
___________________________________
/s/ Jennifer Alderete, City Clerk
